description: Revise one slide of an existing slide deck from a prompt, instead of regenerating the whole deck. RPC-backed. `slide_index` is zero-based. The call returns as soon as the revision is accepted; poll list_content for the result.

prompt.description: What to change on that slide.

name: revise_slide

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
